items.title: [负面] I adore this game, the story and gameplay, but I c...
items.summary:
I adore this game, the story and gameplay, but I cannot in good conscience get myself to spend any more money or invest hours of my time in the endgame anymore after the changes the developers have made, and the path they seem intent on going down. Reinventing a wheel that didn't need to be reinvented by making every new character have anti synergy with old ones due to the new realms, and retroactively harming nearly every character in the game because of these changes that a large portion of the community actively oppose. The Dtide changes likewise have made many characters people have invested in far less useful unless they have any sort of max hp% damage due to the hp inflation that the dev refuses to go back on. I really hope things look up soon, but I'm not very hopeful.
I'd still reccomend the game for the story, but the only endgame content there is is no longer worth putting your time into, and getting attached to any old character will only end in misfortune, as they will retroactively get weaker when in the same team as newer units due to them changing the fundamental rules the characters were built around in the first place. The dev is casting aside the care of the global players to bring in features from the JP server that they believe match their vision better than what they initially did in global, in an attempt to mix two different game designs while harming anything that already existed beforehand.
Listen to the music if you can, enjoy the story when you're able, but I cannot reccomend investing any degree of money or extended time with the new vision the developer has for this game.

items.title: [负面] The direction the developers have taken this game...
items.summary:
The direction the developers have taken this game in regards to player retention and the endgame are laughable, even going so far as to send you hush money just so that their changes to the end game or lack thereof can be seen as "positive" when it isn't. 
If you must play this game, play it to experience the story if anything. 
I'm wiling to change my review if the game receives meaningful changes but.. I am not hopeful.

items.title: [正面] И так. Наиграл 155 часов! Я пробовал многие донатк...
items.summary:
И так. Наиграл 155 часов! Я пробовал многие донатки и мало какая смогла увлечь хотя бы часов на 20, что лично для меня показатель( да и не ток донатки, мало че держит больше 10 часов). Сюжет, оч неплох, лор прописан интересно, но больше меня затянуло пвп, да разобраться че как играть не просто, много статусов, параметров и условностей, продраться сквозь все это судя по всему дано не каждому, но коли осилить, становиться интересно, да в чем то игра кривая и косая, но ее плюсы с лихвой это компенсируют. Скрепя сердце ставлю 8 баллов из 10.
П.с. типы которые наиграли 2 часа и написали негативный отзыв, вы для меня загадка.
